description: CHORAS default geometry-issue compatibility baseline. Every simulation method inherits this list. A method may ship its own override file (referenced by 'geometryCompatibility' in methods-config.json) that copies these entries and overrides only the fields that differ. The override is merged on top of this baseline per issue kind.

compatibilityLevels.compatible: The issue does not affect this simulation method; the geometry can be used as-is.
compatibilityLevels.warning: The issue is tolerated but may reduce accuracy or require review.
compatibilityLevels.incompatible: The issue breaks this simulation method and must be repaired before running.

duplicate_vertex.label: Duplicate vertex
duplicate_vertex.description: Two or more vertices share the same coordinates within tolerance.

zero_area_face.label: Zero area face
zero_area_face.description: A face has zero or near-zero area (collapsed/sliver triangle).

non_planar_face.label: Non-planar face
non_planar_face.description: A polygon face whose vertices do not lie on a single plane.

t_junction.label: T-junction
t_junction.description: A vertex lies on the interior of another face's edge, breaking edge connectivity.

intersection.label: Self-intersection
intersection.description: Faces intersect each other, violating a piecewise-linear-complex (PLC).

boundary_edge.label: Boundary edge
boundary_edge.description: An edge bordered by a single face, indicating a non-watertight surface.

possible_hole.label: Possible hole
possible_hole.description: A closed loop of boundary edges suggesting a gap in the surface.

small_face.label: Small face
small_face.description: A face whose area is below the recommended size threshold.

collinear_face.label: Collinear face
collinear_face.description: A face whose vertices are collinear or nearly collinear (collapsed to a line).

overlapping_face.label: Overlapping faces
overlapping_face.description: Two or more faces occupy the same space, causing potential simulation issues.
